title: Porch observation (schema 2)
description: Output of porch observe, each element of porch list's sessions, and each line of porch watch.

attached.description: Porch's inside part runs in the session (Claude Code: a hook record written by the listed process; Pi: the extension). porch list and porch watch show only attached sessions unless --all is given.

since.description: When the session entered its status, or null when Porch cannot tell. For ended, when it ended.

endReason.description: Why an ended session ended: the harness's own reason (Claude Code: the SessionEnd hook's reason; Pi: the session_shutdown reason), or, where the harness skipped its end hook, a reason Porch read from the harness (Claude Code: idle, stopped for being idle, read from its daemon log). Null when there is none, and for every other status.

sessionStatus.description: ended: the session ended cleanly. gone: it is not running and did not end cleanly.
